svg.title: The path of a request through the Worker
svg.desc: Telegram calls the Worker at /telegram with a button or a text of the maintainer, the GitHub App at /github with an event, and the control repository at /control with an answer. src/index.ts turns away every other path and method and hands the rest to Serial, the one Durable Object of src/serial.ts, which runs one change at a time, as it does with the run of the schedule every 15 minutes. src/routes.ts first checks where a request comes from, by the secret header of Telegram or the signature of GitHub or of the control repository, and refuses it without a change otherwise. updates.ts, rules.ts, control.ts and schedule.ts decide what it means, and pager.ts and actions.ts apply it: the state of the things in Workers KV, through store.ts, one message per thing in Telegram, through render.ts, texts.ts and telegram.ts, and the action of a button on GitHub, through github.ts.
